Please write a function named `triangle`, which draws a triangle of hashes, and takes one argument. The triangle should be as tall and as wide as the value of the argument. The function should call the function `line` from the exercise above for the actual printing out. Copy your solution to that exercise above the code for this exercise. Please don't change anything in the `line` function. Some examples: ```python triangle(6) print() triangle(3) ```
